data.one_liner: A simple date model for Dart with no notion of time.
data.what_it_does: Provides a date-only model as a simpler alternative to Dart's built-in DateTime class. It handles date arithmetic, comparison methods, and date ranges without worrying about time zones or hours.
use_when: You need to handle date-only events like birthdays or anniversaries
You want to avoid time zone complications associated with DateTime
avoid_when: You need to track hours, minutes, seconds, or time zones
You require complex calendar systems beyond standard Gregorian dates
strengths: Simplifies date-only logic without time overhead
weaknesses: Lacks time zone and time-of-day support
